# JuliaupDistributions.jl

> JuliaupDistributions publishes the static files a juliaup client reads, so a Julia distribution can be installed with `juliaup add <channel>` from any static host.

## Documentation

- [JuliaupDistributions.jl](https://s-celles.github.io/JuliaupDistributions.jl/dev/index/)
- [How juliaup works](https://s-celles.github.io/JuliaupDistributions.jl/dev/mechanism/)
- [Publishing](https://s-celles.github.io/JuliaupDistributions.jl/dev/publishing/)
- [Reference](https://s-celles.github.io/JuliaupDistributions.jl/dev/reference/)
